notes: the bracketed «[علي بن الحسين بن]» is the text's own insertion: kept as written; «عليبن» has no space in the text: copied as written
«عن آبائه» names no one: a relation; «عن أبيه علي بن أبي طالب» is one link by the name alone; the Imam after «عن» stays a narrator
